race.comment: Pretty open but feel HAMMURABI (8) is going better than form suggests and looks well placed here. Has raced in richer company last two, and prior to that had won two on end in similar grade to this. Drops back a notch for this and looks a leading player. STOMP'EM (2) was a big winner here two back then scored again here last Wednesday. On the quick back-up but can make it a winning hat-trick. IF I WAS YOU (9) was beaten a length fresh then beaten in a photo here last Wednesday behind CAVENDISH. Backs up quickly and looks close to a win. CAVENDISH (1) is also on the quick turnaround and is flying but has a horror gate to overcome. A host of scratchings would help. I LOVERAIN (10) rates highly on the latest effort and can measure up.
